label: Ping display
description: Round-trip time to the current server.
settings_description: Settings for the Ping display HUD mod. Reads the player's own `NetworkPlayerInfo.responseTime`.

show_label.description: Whether to render the trailing "ms" unit after the number.

good_ms.description: Ping at or below this many milliseconds renders in the good colour.

bad_ms.description: Ping at or above this many milliseconds renders in the bad colour. Must be greater than `good_ms`; not enforced by the schema.

show_host.description: Whether the shortened server name is drawn after the figure. A player who only ever plays one server is being told something they already know, on the chip they look at most often.

show_average.description: Whether the rolling average of the last `window` readings is drawn as a trailing aside, `avg 54`.

show_jitter.description: Whether jitter is drawn as a trailing aside, `±7`: the mean change between consecutive readings over the last `window`. A steady 90 ms plays better than a 40 ms that swings by 30, and only this figure tells the two apart.

jitter_warn_ms.description: Jitter at or above this many milliseconds draws in the warn treatment. 0 disables the warning.

spike_ms.description: A reading this many milliseconds above the rolling average counts as a spike and briefly marks the chip. 0 disables spike detection.

window.description: How many readings the average, the jitter and the spike baseline are taken over. The server sends a new latency every few seconds, so 10 readings is roughly the last half minute.
